entities.summary: Marion Fellows is a Scottish National Party (SNP) politician. From 2015 until 2024, she was the Member of Parliament for Motherwell and Wishaw. Between June 2017 and January 2020 she was the SNP spokesperson for Small Business, Enterprise and Innovations.
